caption: A camera is carried from an air-conditioned lobby out into humid summer heat, and its lens fogs up.

sa.check: A camera is carried from indoors out into the open air.
The lens is clear while still indoors.
The air outside reads as hot and humid.
The fogging comes after stepping outside.

pc.expect: The fog appears once the camera is outside and then clears as it warms; it does not appear while the camera is still indoors.
pc.fail: The lens is fogged while still inside; or the fog appears, clears and appears again with the camera held still outside; or the fog thickens after the lens has cleared; or the fog appears before the camera has moved.

pc.expect: The change is a haze on the lens glass: the view through it blurs where the haze lies and comes back as it clears.
pc.fail: The camera's body changes colour rather than the lens; or the haze lies on the lens barrel and not on the glass; or the view through the lens changes to a different scene as the fog clears; or the lens turns a colour instead of hazing.

pc.expect: Any drops that gather on the lens run downward on the glass.
pc.fail: A drop runs up the lens; or a drop leaves the lens and rises; or water gathers along the lens's top edge and stays.

pc.expect: The fog lies on the glass and nothing else appears or vanishes behind it.
pc.fail: Objects seen through the fogged lens are missing when it clears; or new objects appear behind the fog; or the fog detaches from the lens and drifts as a cloud; or the lens vanishes behind the fog.

pc.expect: One camera with one lens; the camera keeps its shape and nothing passes through the glass.
pc.fail: The lens vanishes; or a second lens appears on the body; or a hand passes through the lens; or the camera changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The camera's body, its markings and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The body changes colour; or the markings change; or the surroundings change between frames.
